name: Luigi Fagioli
features: olive skin, dark hair greying at the temples, dark eyes, square jaw, heavy brows, thickset build, hot-tempered glare
bio: Known as 'the Abruzzi Robber', Luigi Fagioli drove for Maserati, Alfa Romeo and Mercedes-Benz, and was runner-up in the 1935 European Championship. Famously insubordinate — he once chased a team-mate through the Monza paddock with a wheel hammer. In 1951, aged 53, he won the French Grand Prix and remains the oldest winner of a Formula One race.
